'''''Gastroclonium''''' is a genus of [[red algae]] ([[Rhodophyta]]) in the family [[Champiaceae]].<ref name=ab>{{AlgaeBase genus|name=Gastroclonium|id=119}}</ref> {{As of|November 2018}}, according to [[AlgaeBase]], it comprises the following species:<ref name=ab/>

* ''[[Gastroclonium clavatum]]'' <small>(Roth) Ardissone</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium compressum]]'' <small>(Hollenberg) C.F.Chang & B.M.Xia</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium cylindricum]]'' <small>Santelices, I.A.Abbott & Ramírez</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium iyengarii]]'' <small>K.Srinivasan</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium ovatum]]'' <small>(Hudson) Papenfuss</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium pacificum]]'' <small>(E.Y.Dawson) C.F.Chang & B.M.Xia</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium parvum]]'' <small>(Hollenberg) C.F.Chang & B.M.Xia</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium pygmaeum]]'' <small>Funk</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium reflexum]]'' <small>(Chauvin) Kützing</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium trichodes]]'' <small>(C.Pujals) B.Santelices, I.A.Abbott & M.E.Ramírez</small>
* ''[[Gastroclonium xishaense]]'' <small>C.F.Chang & B.M.Xia</small>
